$comment: Ace Hardware (hardware and paint sundries) is behind Cloudflare bot protection: plain HTTP, headless Chrome and AvalAI's page fetch all fail with BOT_PROTECTION, so the site uses the default engine (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance) with ai_fetch web_search. The shop is never contacted; values are unverified (AI_UNVERIFIED), and the search route returns only title and price for this product. Engines tried on 2026-11-19: http and browser: BOT_PROTECTION; ai_fetch http and browser: BOT_PROTECTION; web_search: success (title and price, 573+97 tokens). Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key.
